text:
Sam Patel: Heads up — customer reports free-trial credits landed in a shadow tenant after an SSO migration. Their production org (org_prod_123) shows zero credits, but a cloned/staging workspace (org_shadow_789) has the grant. Anyone seen this pattern?

Lee Nguyen: ugh. can you share the org ids + any grant id or txn id? also when did the SSO sync/run?

Sam Patel: sending what I have: org_prod_123, org_shadow_789, grant id CG-2026-07, billing tx 0xabc123def, apparent grant time 1917601075. customer says they did an SSO migration + workspace clone last week.

Amanda Ortiz: thanks. quick checklist: 1) check audit logs for SSO attribute mappings 2) check billing record for applied_to org 3) see if any automated migration scripts ran after the clone.

Ophelia Chen: can someone run the CLI check?

```bash
# grab billing record
redwood-cli billing get --tx 0xabc123def --json | jq .applied_to
```

Jordan Kim: @Billing Bot can you lookup tx 0xabc123def and confirm which workspace id it attached to?

Billing Bot: Found: grant_id CG-2026-07 applied_to org_shadow_789, grant_source promo_free_trial, applied_at 1917601075. Flagged as out-of-band relative to org_prod_123. Created internal ticket CS-1227.

Sam Patel: I also pulled audit logs: there was an identity mapping change at 1917601005 where the SAML 'tenant' attribute started resolving to org_shadow_789 (looks like a clone leftover). That would explain why the grant landed there.

Amanda Ortiz: remediation proposal:
1) Prepare a dry-run migration script to reassign the credit grant from org_shadow_789 -> org_prod_123 (SQL update on grants table + billing reconciliation)
2) Run reconciliation to ensure token-level billing doesn't double-count
3) Patch SSO mapping so future assertions map to the correct org
4) Notify customer and get explicit approval before commit

I can own the migration script and dry-run. Need a thumbs up from ops and billing to run in prod.

Ophelia Chen: I'll gate the SSO mapping change and put a temporary block on automated syncs for that tenant. Quick mitigation: add mapping override for customer_id=acme-corp to point to org_prod_123.

Jordan Kim: I'll draft the outbound message to the customer explaining root cause + remediation steps + ETA. ETA = EOD tomorrow for dry-run, dependent on approvals.

Sam Patel: once we have the dry-run output, can ops and billing confirm no regressions? Also request a full audit trail export for the customer.

Billing Bot: CS-1227 updated: dry-run requested; billing lead assigned (Amanda Ortiz). No charge changes will be committed without manual approval.

Lee Nguyen: small note — check if any webhooks or internal automation could re-trigger a grant on next sync. If yes, temporarily disable.

Amanda Ortiz: noted. Will include a check in the dry-run that verifies no auto-reissue actions.

Ophelia Chen: I will push the mapping override now (staging) and schedule the production override after Amanda posts dry-run.

Sam Patel: thanks team. I'll keep the customer in the loop. cc @Jordan Kim on the customer comms.

Jordan Kim: got it, will send the first message after we have the dry-run results. :thumbsup:
